note: Meinrad Stenzel: Zum Vulgatatext des Canticum Jonae. _Biblica_ 33 (1952) 356–362.

_de ventre inferni_ (Weber/Gryson) – _de ventre inferi_ (Clementina, NVg) – out of the belly of the underworld (or hell); out of the belly of the dead. Against the Benedictine Vulgate, which has _inferi_, the Weber/Gryson edition prefers _inferni_ as the original Jeromian reading. The latter makes better sense. It may be that Jerome, who uses _inferi_ in his commentary on Jonah, originally had _inferi_, but later corrected it to _inferni_.
